events.title: Kubernetes 1.17 released
events.summary: The Kubernetes project released version 1.17 on December 9, 2019 — stabilizing volume snapshots and deepening cloud provider integrations.
events.about: Kubernetes 1.17 continued the march toward production defaults — CSI volume snapshots, conformance tests, and deprecations that pushed clusters toward supported APIs. It closed out a year when K8s became the assumed orchestration layer.

narrative.whyChosen: Kubernetes 1.17 matured storage snapshots and cloud integrations.
narrative.whyImportant: It reinforced Kubernetes as the default container orchestration platform.
narrative.problemSolved: Stateful workloads needed standardized backup and restore on Kubernetes.
